suggested_fix: No fix required. The index calculations are guarded by the ternary checks on fclks->num_levels (> 2, > 1, > 0), so a small or zero num_levels can no longer cause an unsigned underflow that produces an out-of-bounds index into fclks->data[]. With zero levels every index becomes 0, which is inside the fixed-size data array. As extra hardening, the function could return early when num_levels is 0 and clamp num_levels to the size of the data array.
